challenges.title: Build a World Cup Database CLI
description: Build a command-line application that queries a relational database of World Cup match data.
User Story: The database contains tables for teams, tournaments, and match results with proper foreign keys.
User Story: I can query top scorers, tournament winners, win percentages, and head-to-head records.
User Story: I can insert new match results and the database correctly updates all derived statistics.
Bonus: Implement full-text search on team/player names using LIKE or trigram indexes.
Remember to use Read-Search-Ask if you get stuck.

challenges.title: Build a Number Guessing Game Database
description: Build a number guessing game that stores all game sessions and player statistics in a database.
User Story: The game remembers players by username across sessions.
User Story: Each game session stores the number of guesses and whether the player won.
User Story: On login, players see their best game (fewest guesses) and total games played.
User Story: A leaderboard query shows the top 10 players ranked by best guess count.
Remember to use Read-Search-Ask if you get stuck.

challenges.title: Claim your Relational Databases Certification
description: Congratulations on completing the Relational Databases certification!
You have learned SQL fundamentals, PostgreSQL features, schema design, indexes, transactions, and ACID guarantees.
